senses.gloss: m. (קרז to be round, cmp. קִרְזֵל) name of an earthen vessel.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite> <he>זה … ומצאן ק׳ של וכ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="S01951"><he>קרון</he></cite>) this is one of three men whom the Lord tried and found to be vessels for urine (unworthy; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19:11">Gen. R. s. 19</cite> <he>קנקנין</he>).—Pl. <he>קְרוֹזִים</he>.
Gen. R. s. 86 end ק׳ בכפר חנניה Ar. (ed. קדרים … חנינא) will you import ḳ’rozim to K’far Hananiah? (v. קַדָּר).—V. כְּרוֹז.
